description: Python with venv, pip, pipx and uv, for Linux images

steps.name: Python, venv, pip and pipx from the distribution
steps.run: apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 update && apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 install python3 python3-venv python3-pip python3-dev pipx

update.name: Python, venv, pip and pipx, the distribution's newest
update.run: apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 update && apt-get -q -y -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0 install --only-upgrade python3 python3-venv python3-pip python3-dev pipx

checks: python3 -c 'import sys; assert sys.version_info >= (3, 11), sys.version; print(sys.executable, sys.version.split()[0])'
